tests.code: let mut f = ReadyAfter { left: 0, value: 9 }; let mut cx = Context::from_waker(Waker::noop()); assert_eq!(Pin::new(&mut f).poll(&mut cx), Poll::Ready(9));

let mut f = ReadyAfter { left: 2, value: 5 }; let mut cx = Context::from_waker(Waker::noop()); assert_eq!(Pin::new(&mut f).poll(&mut cx), Poll::Pending); assert_eq!(Pin::new(&mut f).poll(&mut cx), Poll::Pending); assert_eq!(Pin::new(&mut f).poll(&mut cx), Poll::Ready(5));

let c = Arc::new(Wakes(AtomicU32::new(0))); let w = Waker::from(c.clone()); let mut cx = Context::from_waker(&w); let mut f = ReadyAfter { left: 2, value: 5 }; while Pin::new(&mut f).poll(&mut cx).is_pending() {} assert_eq!(c.0.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 2);
